item.text: All four approved posts are ready. The campaign has a $400 lifetime cap, with spend paced at about $33.33 a day from midnight July 30 through the end of August 10, Dublin time. It targets Ireland and the UK, iOS and Android, and climbing-related keywords. I’ll activate it now and check delivery after the first day.

After three days, spend is $92.78 for 48 link clicks. The “Back on the wall” post has the lowest cost per click so far, and the feature-led post has brought the most clicks. I’ll focus the remaining spend on those two. The sample is still small, and this tells us about clicks rather than trial starts.

item.text: With three days left, reported spend is $294.36 for 135 link clicks. The last two days averaged about $1.87 per click, an improvement on the earlier results. I’ll keep the current setup running, check the remaining budget daily, and stop delivery at midnight after August 10, Dublin time.
The flight has ended, and the campaign and both ad groups are paused. I’ll allow another hour for reporting to catch up, then pull the recap totals across both ad groups.

Your July 30–August 10 campaign is complete and paused.

- **Spend:** $398.45 USD of $400
- **Impressions:** 419,833
- **Link clicks:** 186
- **Average cost per click:** $2.14

I monitored daily and focused later spend on the “Back on the wall” and feature-led posts. Trial starts remain available only in your own tracking; X couldn’t measure them without a pixel.
